notes: Curated checks for discovery-and-demo-structure. Apply full-deliverable checks only when that deliverable was requested; score focused revisions on the affected decisions and retained constraints. Definitions are not executed results.

should_trigger.prompt: Please design an adaptive discovery guide and outcome-led demo flow for a defined buyer, segment, stage, and meeting type.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable discovery and demo structure and label anything that still needs confirmation.
I only have partial source material for discovery and demo structure. Make useful progress and label what still needs confirmation.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Please audit a sample of discovery calls with one consistent rubric and turn portfolio-level patterns into manager-ready coaching priorities.
Please review one sales call and turn recording, transcript, or notes evidence into clear coaching priorities and next-practice actions.
Please write persona- and stage-specific spoken language for a defined conversation moment or an existing call structure.

output_structure_checks.name: discovery-and-demo-structure-core-output
output_structure_checks.description: Names the meeting decision and the buyer signal for each demo block. When the buyer cannot articulate the problem, a brief verified example may test relevance before returning to discovery; it does not justify a feature tour.

output_structure_checks.name: discovery-and-demo-structure-decision-discipline
output_structure_checks.description: Makes the requested decision or next action explicit while separating verified evidence, provisional assumptions, conflicts, and decision-critical unknowns.

output_structure_checks.name: discovery-and-demo-structure-practitioner-fit
output_structure_checks.description: Uses only verified capabilities and a clear stop or transition condition for an exploratory example.

task_scenarios.prompt: The operations buyer knows handoffs are frustrating but cannot yet explain where they fail. We have ten minutes and a verified demo of routing a request to another team with an audit history. Give me a short way to use that example to find out whether it is relevant, not a full demo plan.

assertions.name: discovery-and-demo-structure-exploratory-example-1
assertions.description: Uses a bounded exploratory example and a question that tests relevance, then returns to the buyer's actual workflow.

assertions.name: discovery-and-demo-structure-exploratory-example-2
assertions.description: Does not demand complete discovery before showing anything or invent capability, impact, or a lengthy feature tour.
